title: Ni/Ce0.8Zr0.2O2−x solid solution catalyst: a pathway to coke-resistant CO2 reforming of methane
content:
RSC Sustain., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4SU00481G, Paper
Open Access

Rubina Khatun, Rohan Singh Pal, Kapil Bhati, Anil Chandra Kothari, Shivani Singh, Nazia Siddiqui, Swati Rana, Rajaram Bal
The CO2 reforming of methane effectively produces syngas from two major greenhouse gases, CO2 and CH4. Ni/Ce0.8Zr0.2O2−x catalyst shows outstanding performance, with improved stability from oxygen vacancies and strong metal–support interactions.
